modeHelp.off: Nothing happens with comments. This is the default.
modeHelp.dry_run: Comments with a keyword are matched and the message that would go out is written to the log below. Nothing is sent.
modeHelp.live: A comment with a keyword gets a private reply on Instagram, once per comment. The conversation then shows on the Chats page under Instagram.

comments.liveConfirm: Live sends real Instagram messages from this account to people who comment a keyword. Check the rules and the dry-run log first.
comments.switchOff: The server switch INSTAGRAM_DM_LIVE is off, so live works exactly like dry run until it is set on the server.
comments.webhookMissing: The Instagram webhook is not set up on the server yet (INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN and INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET), so no comments arrive.
comments.rulesHelp: When a comment contains the keyword as a word (any case, accents and punctuation ignored), the person gets the first message in DM.
comments.keywordHelp: Letters and digits, for example GUIA. "guia!" and "Guia please" match, "guias" does not.
comments.firstMessageHelp: {username} becomes the person's @name. Keep it short and say what they get.
comments.defaultMessage: Hi {username}! Thanks for your comment. Here is what you asked for:
comments.aiFollowUpHelp: For now this is recorded only: the AI conversation engine has no Instagram channel yet, so replies are answered by a person from Chats.
comments.deleteConfirm: Delete this keyword? Comments with it get no message any more.
comments.logHelp: The latest 50 events: private replies, replies, opt-outs. In dry run this is what would have been sent.

reasons.window_closed: Outside Instagram's window (7 days for a comment, 24 h after their last message).
reasons.engine_not_connected: Not sent: the AI engine has no Instagram channel yet.
reasons.dm_off: Comment to DM is off for this account.
reasons.already_messaged: This person already got this keyword's message.
reasons.unsupported: Only text can be sent as an Instagram DM.

insights.empty: No insights yet. They are read from Instagram every few hours once the account is connected; the first numbers show up within a few hours.
insights.followersNotEnough: Builds up from today: one new point is added every day.
insights.bestSummary: Your posts do best on {{day}} around {{hour}}.
insights.bestUnclear: No weekday or hour stands out yet.
insights.bestHelp: From your posts' views, by when they went out ({{zone}}).
insights.notEnough_one: Not enough data yet: {{count}} post with views, {{min}} needed.
insights.notEnough_other: Not enough data yet: {{count}} posts with views, {{min}} needed.
insights.fewPostsTip: Too few posts to count for Best
insights.bestLegend: Faded bars have only one post. Best only counts slots with {{min}} or more posts. The small number is the post count.
insights.highPerformer: At least twice the median views of your posts
insights.highLegend: Marked posts have at least twice the median views.
insights.skipped: Not available from Instagram for this account right now: {{metrics}}.
